permit.quote: Microsoft Azure screens the data that is temporarily stored at Amazon Web Services.

prohibit.quote: No data is stored outside of your device.

conflicts.situation: A user enters text or uploads an image in Lenovo Creator Zone, and the content is screened while held on Amazon Web Services servers.
conflicts.reason: Temporary storage at Amazon Web Services is storage outside the device. The same paragraph states both without a time limit or exception, so the absolute statement that no data is stored outside the device cannot hold.

permit.quote: Motorola will share information collected through Mototalk with third parties to enable the operation of Mototalk and to provide you with technical support for Mototalk and support Motorola's consumer relations and first-party marketing efforts.

prohibit.quote: This personal information is only used within the mobile application and made available only to other Mototalk users.

conflicts.situation: Motorola uses a Mototalk user's profile phone number and email address to support its first-party marketing and shares them with third parties for that purpose.
conflicts.reason: The sharing statement covers all information collected through Mototalk, including public profile data. The restriction says profile data is used only within the app and only for other users. Neither statement is made an exception to the other.

permit.quote: Lenovo collects device ID, function usage to understand user needs and optimize feature design.

prohibit.quote: Lenovo Smart Scanner does not collect any personal data from users.

conflicts.situation: A user runs Lenovo Smart Scanner, and Lenovo collects the device ID and function usage data.
conflicts.reason: Section s23 lists device identifiers as personal information, while s3 calls them non-personal. The policy does not settle which classification applies, so the statement that no personal data is collected may conflict with device ID collection.

permit.quote: To provide this functionality, Legion Arena needs to detect the apps installed on the device, and collect the device SN number and software version number.

prohibit.quote: Lenovo does not collect any personal data, nor does Lenovo share any data with others.

conflicts.situation: A user of Legion Arena on a Lenovo tablet receives app update tips, and Legion Arena collects the device serial number.
conflicts.reason: The policy treats product serial numbers as personal information in registration (s2) and lists device identifiers as personal information (s23). The absolute statement that Lenovo collects no personal data has no exception for this feature.

permit.quote: After such time, we will retain a core set of information for MIT’s legitimate purposes, such as archival, scientific, and historical research and for the defense of potential legal claims.

prohibit.quote: We will always respect a request by you to stop processing your personal information (subject to our legal obligations).

conflicts.situation: A visitor asks MIT to stop processing their personal information, and MIT retains a core set of it for archival, scientific, and historical research.
conflicts.reason: The promise to stop processing excepts only legal obligations. Retention for archival and research purposes is not a legal obligation, and the policy does not say which statement governs after the request.

permit.quote: This means that we will maintain a record for you until such time as you tell us that you no longer wish us to keep in touch.

prohibit.quote: In such cases, it is our intent that your provided information will be used only to fulfill the request(s) you make of us, and to allow us to contact you if there are any problems with your request.

conflicts.situation: A visitor submits name and email through a web form on the main MIT website for a one-time request, and MIT keeps the record to stay in touch.
conflicts.reason: The form statement limits use to fulfilling the request and contacting about problems. The retention statement keeps a record for ongoing contact until the person objects. The policy does not say whether web form submitters fall under the lifelong record.

permit.quote: When you subscribe to any plans, we collect your payment details, and other information to process your payments, including your payment / purchase history, billing address, gift cards and promotional offers that you may have redeemed.

prohibit.quote: We never seek, store or retain credit card numbers of users

conflicts.situation: A user subscribes to a Kuku plan and pays by credit card, and Kuku collects payment details to process the payment.
conflicts.reason: Payment details for a card payment include the card number. The policy does not say that card numbers are excluded from collected payment details or are handled only by a payment processor.

permit.quote: We also reserve the right to share/transfer any information including personal information relating to the Users with another party in case of a merger, acquisition, amalgamation, or sale of all or part of Our assets to a third party.

prohibit.quote: We do not sell, trade, rent or otherwise transfer to third parties, Your personal information.

conflicts.situation: Kuku sells part of its assets to a third party and transfers users' personal information with the assets.
conflicts.reason: The absolute statement against transfers is followed by an exception only for service providers. The merger transfer is a separate reservation, and the policy does not state that it overrides the statement against transfers.
